title: Wayang Shadow Puppets
summary: Wayang kulit is the shadow theatre of Java and Bali. A single puppeteer, the dalang, moves cut and painted buffalo-hide figures behind a lit cloth and speaks every voice, while a gamelan orchestra plays beside the cloth.
howToPlay: Watch each scene as the shadows play it on the lit screen.
Tap a choice, or press its number, to decide what happens next.
When the old farmer asks a riddle, pick the answer you think is right.
Wit, goodwill and water build as you choose; your ending gives one to three stars.
rules: The tale branches several ways and has three possible endings.
Patient, kind and clever choices earn wisdom points; shouting and shortcuts earn none.
Some choices make you late or unkind, and those cannot be undone.
The riddle is answered once; a wrong answer is not fatal but costs wit.
Three stars need wit, goodwill and no delays.
heritageNote: Wayang kulit has been performed on Java and Bali for many centuries and is recognised internationally as a masterpiece of living heritage. Puppeteers, musicians and puppet-makers keep it alive, often within families. This tale is an original village story in the style of its clown-servant comedies.
